# apple_game_center_detail (Data Source)

Reads the Game Center detail of an app, which exists once Game Center is on for the app.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_game_center_detail" "example" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `arcade_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app is on Apple Arcade.
- `game_center_group_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app's Game Center group. Null without one.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center detail.
